concepts.name: Open-Bay Four-Bar Pin Cradle
concepts.mechanism_family: Roller intake feeding a four-bar lifting cradle
concepts.scoring_sequence: Capture a lying or upright Pin between compliant rollers, settle it into the curved cradle, then raise and tip the four-bar to place it onto a Goal.
concepts.distinguishing_idea: The open-front chassis surrounds the object while paired four-bar links keep a deep cradle approximately level through most of the lift.
concepts.main_uncertainty: Approximate cradle clearances and passive orientation behavior require development; joints and controllers are not implemented in this preview.

concepts.name: Belt-Mast Cup Fork
concepts.mechanism_family: Two-stage belt elevator with centering funnel and fork carriage
concepts.scoring_sequence: Draw a Cup through the low funnel, center it against the carriage, elevate it vertically, and extend the fork slightly forward for controlled placement.
concepts.distinguishing_idea: A compact nested mast separates vertical lift from the short placement stroke, avoiding a long swinging arm.
concepts.main_uncertainty: Cup retention during carriage acceleration and belt routing are unresolved; joints and controllers are not implemented in this preview.

concepts.name: Rotary Pin Indexing Drum
concepts.mechanism_family: Horizontal-axis indexing drum with intake throat and discharge p‑
concepts.scoring_sequence: Feed a Pin into one drum pocket, rotate the drum to orient and elevate it, then open the upper guide gate so the pocket rolls it onto the Goal.
concepts.distinguishing_idea: Acquisition, reorientation, and lift are combined in a quarter-turn pocketed drum rather than a separate arm and gripper.
concepts.main_uncertainty: Pocket geometry for both upright and lying Pins is approximate; joints and controllers are not implemented in this preview.

concepts.name: Scissor Basket Goal Loader
concepts.mechanism_family: Scissor lift carrying a split-entry retention basket
concepts.scoring_sequence: Sweep a Pin or Cup into the low basket, close the flexible entry rollers, raise the basket vertically with the scissor, and tilt its floor to release onto a Goal.
concepts.distinguishing_idea: The game object remains in one guarded basket from floor pickup through scoring while the symmetric scissor supplies elevation.
concepts.main_uncertainty: Scissor stiffness, basket tipping clearance, and track packaging are conceptual; joints and controllers are not implemented in this preview.

concepts.name: Articulated Conveyor Bridge
concepts.mechanism_family: Segmented belt conveyor with an over-center scoring bridge
concepts.scoring_sequence: Collect a lying Pin or Cup onto the lower conveyor, carry it up between side guides, then rotate the upper conveyor segment over the Goal for a gentle powered discharge.
concepts.distinguishing_idea: A continuous transfer path uses a fixed lower incline and independently pivoting upper bridge instead of lifting the object in a carriage.
concepts.main_uncertainty: Transition behavior between conveyor segments and object stability near the hinge remain unresolved; joints and controllers are not implemented in this preview.
